title: 卡
teacherNotes: Release integrated L274 on latest origin/main; dependencies resolved: L271, L272, L273.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L274.
usageNotes: Do not use 住 in display text, spokenText, displayLines, or Stage 4 option text.
Lock 卡 to jammed/stuck usage: 卡得很緊, 卡死, 卡在.
Images may depict jammed objects, but the image itself must not contain text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, or watermarks.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for every image.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Tiredness and low-energy scenes must be gentle and safe, with no severe illness, emergency, horror, mockery, or panic.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 卡 as public/assets/lessons/L274/audio/char-u5361.m4a from the single character pronounced ㄎㄚˇ.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在桌邊想打開一個盒子，但盒子卡得很緊打不開。盒子不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角爸爸在家門或房門旁試著推門或拉門，但門卡死了動不了。畫面要清楚是門卡住但不可使用「住」字；不可有門牌、文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩坐在家裡，看起來精神很差，不想動，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要溫和，不要做成嚴重醫療場景；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角爸爸在家試穿舊褲子，褲腳卡在腳上不好穿，表情自然、不誇張。畫面要避免嘲笑身材；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角老太太走了一段路後停下來休息，體力變差走不動，主角小女孩在旁邊陪她或扶著她。畫面要溫和，不可有嘲笑感；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。

stage4Plan.reason: 「門卡死了」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。
